DECLARE
  v_wallet_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT w.id INTO v_wallet_id 
  FROM public.wallets w 
  WHERE w.user_id = p_user_id;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.video_url,
    a.title,
    COALESCE(ap.duration_seconds, 30)::INT AS duration_seconds,
    
    -- FIXED: This line now reads the exact reward amount!
    COALESCE(ap.reward_amount, 0)::BIGINT AS reward_amount,
    
    CASE WHEN v_wallet_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
    ELSE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions t
      WHERE t.wallet_id = v_wallet_id
        AND t.reference_id = a.id
        AND t.type = 'reward'
        AND t.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    ) END AS is_on_cooldown
  FROM public.ads a
  LEFT JOIN public.purchased_packages pp ON a.purchased_package_id = pp.id
  LEFT JOIN public.advertiser_packages ap ON pp.package_id = ap.id
  WHERE a.status = 'active';
END;
